# Cncf Interlink Reviewer

Review Interlink using its official documentation and repository in the Runtime / Container Runtime category. InterLink aims to provide an abstraction for the execution of a Kubernetes pod on any remote resource capable of managing a Container execution lifecycle thanks to the Virtual Kubelet interface. It allows you to extend your cloud environment anywhere by running Kubernetes workloads on various infrastructures, creating a seamless cloud-native experience across diverse environments.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
